newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine car production rises 9.6 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Argentine car production rises 9.6 pct in 1996.

text.p: Argentina's car production rose 9.6 percent to 312,910 vehicles in 1996, the ADEFA car manufacturers association said Tuesday.
December output surged 39.9 percent from the same month of the previous year to 25,494 units, but dropped from November's 31,794 units for season reasons.
Car exports soared 106.7 percent to 109,041 units in 1996 and domestic sales rose 14.7 percent to 376,109.
December exports totaled 8,392 vehicles, up 120.9 percent from December 1995 and down 35.3 percent from November.
Local sales in December jumped 67.5 percent to 43,297 units, rising 25.5 percent from November.
